description.describe_ch: 韓國文化由韓國傳統文化衍生而來。韓國現代文化是韓國現代化的產物。隨著韓國經濟和社會的發展，韓國人的食衣住行等生活方式也發生了變化，從而構築了現代韓國文化。韓國文化在亞洲和世界的流行被稱為韓流。本課程是因應國際交流需要而開課，著重於專業的知識整合，借此提昇學生的韓國文化素養、拓展其知識視野，目的在增進學生的韓國知識，提升思考能力等。
description.describe_eh: Korean culture derived from traditional Korean culture. South Korea's modern culture is a product of the modern Korea. With the economic and social development in South Korea, the basic necessities of the Korean lifestyle changes, to build a modern Korean culture. South Korean popular culture in Asia and the world is known as the Korean Wave. This course is international communication needs commencement, focuses on the integration of professional knowledge to enhance students 'cultural literacy Korea to expand their horizons of knowledge, aims to increase students' knowledge to enhance the ability to think.
